scope: Word table fidelity: rows whose cells hold several paragraphs are paginated by the row-flow kernel (Word splits such rows across pages), and the row scale is recalibrated so the bid document lands on Word's 546 pages without any page overflowing

reference.wordPages: web/.tmp/word-page-text.json — Word pages 531-533 carry the YCK_8 / YCK9 rows that continue over several pages
reference.docxStructure: word/document.xml: tables 6 and 7 ("Số CTKT…") hold 30 and 18 cells with up to 6 and 7 paragraphs per cell; tables 0, 8, 10 and 12 also have multi-paragraph cells
reference.before: web/.tmp/word-overflow.json — pages 529 (2523px), 530 (2362px), 531 (11766px) and 533 (6312px) each drew a table taller than the 1056px page, and page 535 held a single empty paragraph

cause.measurement:
office-webapp.component.ts rejected every table whose cell had more than one

(usable = false), so no row-flow data was produced for those tables
cause.pagination: without row-flow the row-level splitter must place at least one whole row per page, so a row taller than the page was drawn in full and spilled far past the page bottom
cause.effect: one Word row that spans four pages was stacked on a single page, which both hid content and made the 546-page count accidentally match Word

changes.measurement:
office-webapp.component.ts: every

in a cell contributes its rendered height; the line count is measured over the cell's joined text and paragraphStarts records where each paragraph begins
changes.slicing: word-paginate.ts: new sliceCellParagraphs() maps a line slice back onto the paragraphs it covers, keeping each paragraph's own formatting instead of always slicing the first one
changes.calibration: office-webapp.component.ts: rowFlowScale default 1.23 -> 1.162, the value that keeps Word's 546 pages once tall rows split instead of overflowing
changes.regression: scripts/smoke.mts: sliceCellParagraphs across three paragraphs (375 checks total)

probes.pageOverflowBefore: headless Edge CDP on the built plugin: article.scrollHeight 2627/2466/11870/6416 on pages 529/530/531/533 against a 1056px page
probes.blankPageBefore: page 535 held one empty paragraph because the paginator believed page 534 was full; Word page 535 starts the "Kinh nghiệm phát triển" chapter
probes.afterSplit: with the split fix at the old scale: 576 pages, 0 overflowing pages, largest table fragment 918px
probes.scaleSweep: same capture at rowFlowScale 1.20 -> 563 pages, 1.18 -> 555, 1.166 -> 550, 1.162 -> 546, 1.158 -> 543, 1.15 -> 541; every value 0 overflowing pages

verification.overflow: 0 pages with content taller than the page box (was 4)
verification.largestTable: 920px, inside the 894px content area of the 1056px page (was 11,766px)
verification.uiBuild: npm run office:ui:build — main.js 966 kB, styles.css 146 kB

remaining: Page-level row start still drifts from Word inside the long table: Word's line metrics and the 6px vs 7.2px default cell margin are not modelled, so most table pages stay below Dice 0.8 even though the total page count matches
Composite border styles (thinThickSmallGap, thickThinSmallGap, double) still render as one thin line and table-level w:jc/w:tblW alignment is not applied
Word's 108-twip (7.2px) default cell side margin is still drawn at 6px; applying 7.2px moves pagination away from 546 pages
